description: This file defines a utility class 'NoteUtil' for handling note-related operations in an Android application, such as generating excerpts and titles, processing markdown, and retrieving font size preferences.

classes.name: NoteUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing functions for note manipulation, such as generating excerpts and titles, markdown processing, and font size preferences.

methods.name: isEmptyLine
methods.description: Checks if a line is empty, considering markdown removal and whitespace.

methods.name: truncateString
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: generateNoteExcerpt
methods.description: Creates an excerpt from note content, excluding the title if it starts the content.

methods.name: generateNonEmptyNoteTitle
methods.description: Generates a note title, defaulting to a string resource if the content yields an empty title.

methods.name: generateNoteTitle
methods.description: Extracts the first non-empty line as the title of the content.

methods.name: getLineWithoutMarkdown
methods.description: Retrieves a specified line from content, removing markdown formatting and skipping empty lines.

methods.name: extendCategory
methods.description: Replaces slashes with spaced slashes in category strings.

methods.name: getFontSizeFromPreferences
methods.description: Determines font size based on user preferences.
